block.berongsmp.evacuation_map.desc: Right-click to point yourself toward the nearest marked exit.
block.berongsmp.emergency_light.desc: Lights up automatically for the duration of any active simulation.
block.berongsmp.sprinkler_head.desc: Rains water below it during a fire, extinguishing at most one fire block at a time.
block.berongsmp.smoke_detector.desc: Sounds an alarm once fire is detected within range during a fire simulation.
block.berongsmp.exit_sign.desc: Always-lit wayfinding marker, readable even in smoke or blackout.
block.berongsmp.classroom_globe.desc: A desk globe for the geography corner.
block.berongsmp.podium_lectern.desc: A speaker's podium bearing the school seal.
block.berongsmp.blackboard.desc: A traditional green chalkboard with a chalk tray.
block.berongsmp.water_dispenser.desc: A bottled-water cooler. Right-click for a drink.
block.berongsmp.trophy_cabinet.desc: A glass-front cabinet displaying the school's trophies.
block.berongsmp.philippine_flag_stand.de: The Philippine flag on a brass pole stand.
block.berongsmp.tall_bookshelf.desc: A full-height library bookshelf — plenty of fuel for a library fire.
block.berongsmp.armchair_desk.desc: A classic Philippine classroom armchair-desk with a writing-tablet arm.
block.berongsmp.teachers_desk.desc: The teacher's desk, with a drawer pedestal.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_table.desc: A long lunch table with attached bench seats.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_tray_stack.des: A stack of colored plastic lunch trays.
block.berongsmp.serving_counter.desc: A steam-table serving counter with a sneeze guard. Stack two for a full-height guard.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_menu_board.des: A chalk-surface board listing today's menu.
block.berongsmp.condiment_station.desc: Ketchup, mustard, and a napkin holder on a metal tray.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_trash_bin.desc: A dual recycle/trash bin with swing-flap lids.
block.berongsmp.soda_fountain_machine.de: A drink dispenser with a selection panel and fill nozzle.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_stool.desc: A round vinyl-seat stool on a chrome pole.
block.berongsmp.salad_bar.desc: A refrigerated salad bar with chilled produce wells. Stack two for a full-height guard.
block.berongsmp.snack_vending_machine.de: A glass-front snack machine. Stack two for a full-height unit with a lit marquee.
berongsmp.configuration.title: Berong SMP Configs
block.berongsmp.plastic_trash_bin.desc: A vaping device left smoldering inside can flash into a fire if left unattended.
block.berongsmp.daisy_chain_extension.de: Too many devices sharing one cord risks an overloaded, arcing outlet.
block.berongsmp.woodshop_sawdust_layer.d: Fine sawdust builds up on the floor and can flash-ignite once it gets deep enough.
block.berongsmp.stage_spotlight.desc: An overheating lamp housing can scorch nearby rigging and curtains.
block.berongsmp.archive_box_stack.desc: A stack of paper document boxes is dense fuel for a fast-spreading fire.
block.berongsmp.dust_choked_pc.desc: Dust-clogged vents trap heat inside the case until components overheat.
block.berongsmp.charging_cart.desc: A rolling cart charging too many devices at once can overload its own wiring.
block.berongsmp.frayed_console_wire.desc: Bare copper exposed by a frayed wire can arc and ignite nearby carpet.
block.berongsmp.malfunctioning_vending.d: A shorted compressor can smoke and overheat the machine from the inside.
block.berongsmp.ceiling_projector.desc: A failed cooling fan lets internal heat build up until it starts smoking.
block.berongsmp.swollen_phone_battery.de: A thermally swollen battery can vent flammable gas without warning.
block.berongsmp.damaged_lipo_pack.desc: A punctured drone battery pack can smoke and ignite if left in place.
block.berongsmp.vape_in_iron_locker.desc: A vaping device left inside can overheat and smoke inside the closed locker.
block.berongsmp.pa_system_backup.desc: A faulty backup amplifier can arc and overheat its rack-mounted electronics.
block.berongsmp.smartboard_inverter.desc: Roof-leak water damage on the inverter risks a short circuit.
block.berongsmp.unattended_grease_pan.de: A frying pan left on a lit stove burner is one of the most common kitchen fire starters. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.grease_clogged_hood.desc: Built-up grease in a clogged range hood filter can ignite from the heat below. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.contaminated_kitchen_bin: Oil-soaked rags in the bin can self-heat and smoulder. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.jammed_panini_press.desc: Food jammed against a hot press plate can burn and smoke unattended. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.commercial_deep_fryer.de: An overheated deep fryer is a Class K oil fire risk. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher — never spray water or ABC powder on burning oil.
block.berongsmp.clogged_exhaust_fan.desc: A dust-caked, stalled motor can overheat and smoulder inside the housing.
block.berongsmp.alcohol_dispenser_statio: Sanitizer leaking near a power outlet is a flammable-liquid ignition risk.
block.berongsmp.leaking_gas_valve.desc: A leaking LPG line can flash-ignite the whole cafeteria kitchen area. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.unattended_shrine_candle: An open flame burning beside altar cloth is one of the fastest-failing hazards in the building.
block.berongsmp.jammed_laser_printer.des: Paper jammed against the fuser assembly can scorch and smoke.
Condensation leaking into the unit's own wiring risks an electrical short.
block.berongsmp.overloaded_breaker_panel: A panel drawing far more load than it's rated for can arc inside the box.
block.berongsmp.reagent_storage_shelf.de: A tipped, leaking reagent bottle gives off fumes across a wide area.
block.berongsmp.bunsen_burner_station.de: A burner left running unattended is an open flame next to lab chemicals.
block.berongsmp.overloaded_microwave.des: An overloaded microwave can arc internally and catch fire if left running.
